integrity: Original finite certificate and two distinct replay implementations supplied; no authorship or independent verification asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact base result is proved by a complete 32-leaf certificate for a six-edge graph; the unbounded family uses a mathematical additivity argument, not enumeration. No exact general formula for graph acyclic-orientation Littlestone dimension is claimed. Historical publication priority and independent audit remain open.
title: A sharp first adaptive-shattering gap for acyclic graph orientations and connected subcubic amplifiers
